title: Ep 7 — Gemini crosses a billion users, and the mockup generator earning twelve thousand a month
description: Google's Gemini app reportedly crosses one billion monthly users, OpenAI puts restaurant bookings inside ChatGPT, and Anthropic cancels a scheduled Claude Sonnet five price rise while extending its Compliance API to local Cowork and Claude Code sessions. Plus a deep dive on an AI mockup generator for merch sellers that reached twelve thousand dollars a month, and a fifth quiet week for PlayFundWin, LeaguePages and EV-Partnerships regulation.
